nodes.bdb: Genubath = "theft" son of Hadad, an Edomite of the royal family, by an Egyptian princess, the sister of Tahpenes, the queen of the Pharaoh who governed Egypt in the latter part of the reign of David

nodes.g: Tahpenes = "wife of the king" an Egyptian queen in the times of David and Solomon
